author: Varun Manchanda
title: Pathetic customer service
review:
Worst customer service. I ordered on 8th with the expected delivery of 14th.
I didn’t receive delivery and started chasing. They have created an incident on 16th. I continued chasing daily and i got same response that we are actively working on your incident but I haven’t seen even a single response on the incident.
Customer care person mentioned on 17th that I will receive my order in 24 hours.
When I didn’t receive order till 20th. I tried talking to customer care again.
Representatives Unnati and Abhishek continued saying that we want to build the trust but when I asked about delivery of the order, they again commented that I will get in 24 hours.
I checked on 21st evening, my order was cancelled automatically.
Pathetic experience, if you can’t deliver, tell this the very first time. Why waste customer’s time and effort?
I will try to keep the order minimal or may be not order from such non-reliable companies.

author: krriishhx
title: Been Ordering Since 2016. Today, I’m Done.
review:
I’ve been ordering from Myntra since 2016–17, and after what happened with my latest order, I genuinely cannot believe how badly this platform has deteriorated.

I ordered a pair of Roadster shoes. It took ages to arrive, and when I finally went to the shipment warehouse at my university mall to collect it, the staff were completely inattentive and acted like they couldn’t care less.

But the real shock came when I got back to my room and opened the package.

Instead of the Roadster shoes I ordered, I received some cheap-looking knockoffs from a completely different brand called “Amico.”

I immediately contacted customer support, only to be greeted by an absolutely useless chatbot. There was no straightforward option to speak to a real person. I had to click through an absurd number of menus just to reach an actual support agent.

And then, when I finally got there, the app itself started glitching. I couldn’t even upload a photo of the product I received. It just sat there endlessly saying “Uploading…”

This is not what you expect from a platform I’ve been trusting with my orders for nearly a decade.

Wrong product. Poor delivery experience. Unhelpful staff. A frustrating support system. And then an app that doesn’t even let you submit the evidence needed to resolve the issue.

Myntra, this is absolutely unacceptable.

After almost 10 years of ordering from you, this is the last time I’m using Myntra. You’ve completely lost my trust.

author: Debadrita Paul
title: Myntra selling fake brand product
review:
Please do not buy anything from Myntra, as they are selling fake products and refusing to take accountability. I ordered an H&M pair of jeans that turned out to be ill-fitted, but when the delivery agent arrived for the pickup, he outright refused the return, claiming that the brand name "H&M" was not engraved on the button. How is an everyday consumer supposed to inspect microscopic details like button engravings when all the original tags and packaging were completely intact?
Myntra delivered a counterfeit item in the first place, and now their customer support has trapped me in a loop of empty promises. Since August 14th—nearly a week now—they have repeatedly delayed resolving the issue with false assurances of "24 to 48 hours." Their callback service fails to connect, customer care lines are perpetually busy, and no one has initiated the pickup or processed my refund. This is not merely about the cost of the jeans; it is a breach of consumer trust. If Myntra delivers a fake product, penalizing the customer and refusing a legitimate return is unacceptable. Avoid shopping on Myntra unless you are willing to risk losing your money on counterfeit items with zero customer support.

At present, I no longer consider Myntra a trustworthy shopping platform based on my experience. In my experience, the situation becomes even more frustrating when the logistics partner allegedly makes no genuine attempt to collect the return, yet the return is marked as cancelled or failed based on the pickup agent’s own status update. What is even more concerning is the suspension or deactivation of a customer’s account while valid returns, refunds, and the customer’s money remain unresolved. This leaves customers feeling helpless and raises serious concerns about the transparency and accountability of the platform’s return, logistics, and account-management processes. author: Manuranjan S
title: Getting worse day day by

Worse still, the platform has developed a troubling pattern of sending incorrect or poor-quality items. There have been instances where customers order premium products, only to receive cheaper substitutes — sometimes without original tags, raising serious concerns about authenticity and quality control. It almost feels like the original branded product is retained in their warehouse, and a lower-grade item is shipped instead.
This not only undermines trust but also reflects poorly on Myntra’s handling of inventory and commitment to customer satisfaction. The return and refund process isn’t always smooth either, adding another layer of inconvenience. If you have plenty of time and patience, you might be able to navigate through these issues — but for most people, shopping on Myntra has gone from hassle-free to highly unreliable.
It’s disappointing to see a once-dependable platform fall short on the basics: timely delivery, product accuracy, and transparent communication.

review:

However, due to an issue with their logistics partner, the return was not delivered back to them. Even though the system acknowledged the return request, they completely refused to refund me. I was left with no product (right or wrong) and had to absorb a shameless loss of ₹3.8K.
* Repeat Offense: I foolishly let the first incident pass, thinking it was a one-off system glitch. Then, the exact same cycle happened again.
While other e-commerce companies, even their parent company, Flipkart are continually making their customer policies better, Myntra is going down the drain. author: Goru Mina
title: Myntra aap review
review:
User-Friendly Interface:
Many users find the app easy to navigate and appreciate the intuitive design. 
Wide Selection:
Myntra boasts a vast collection of fashion and lifestyle products, with a variety of brands and styles. 
Personalized Recommendations:
The app's ability to suggest items based on user preferences is a well-liked feature. 
Fast Returns (sometimes):
Some users have reported positive experiences with Myntra's return process, with quick refunds and courier pick-ups. 
Secure Payments:
Myntra offers secure payment and EMI options, making it easy to purchase items. 
Negative Aspects:
Delivery Issues:
Some users have experienced delayed deliveries or inconsistent delivery times. 
App Performance:
Occasional problems with the app hanging or not working smoothly have been reported. 
Return/Exchange Headaches:

What I love the most:

•  Super convenient COD + easy returns. Return pickup is hassle-free and refunds are quick.
•  Quality of images and product descriptions are top-notch. What you see is almost always what you get.
•  Wishlist and “Save for later” features are perfect for tracking favorite items.
Delivery is usually on time (often earlier than promised), and the packaging is neat. Customer support is responsive too.
If you love fashion and want a premium yet affordable shopping experience, just download the Myntra app. You won’t regret it! 💖
Highly recommended! 5/5 🔥

title: Safety Risk, Zero Customer Support – Avoid This App
review:
I had a deeply disturbing experience with Myntra that goes beyond poor service — this is about customer safety.

I ordered a product and returned it due to fitting issues. The delivery associate checked the seal and brand tags at pickup and processed the refund. Everything was done as per protocol.

A day later, the same delivery associate started calling me repeatedly (6–7 times), accusing me of fraud and claiming I had returned a fake product. The item had already been out of my possession for over 24 hours. As a customer, I can only verify authenticity through seals and tags — which were intact.

Then the situation escalated. He demanded money and threatened to come to my house with people if I didn’t pay.

This is not just bad service — this is harassment and a serious safety concern.

I immediately tried contacting Myntra support through the app, calls, and email. There is no real customer support. Only chatbots and automated replies. No option to speak to a human. The system kept saying someone would contact me in 24–48 hours.

In a situation involving threats, 24–48 hours is unacceptable.

Despite sharing the delivery agent’s details, I received no immediate help. The situation escalated so quickly that I had to pay extra money just to protect my family.

Customers share their home addresses and trust these platforms. When something goes wrong, and there is no real support system, you are left completely vulnerable.

This was my last transaction with Myntra.

Avoid this app if you value your safety.

author: Shyam Ag
title: Stylish, Comfortable & Great Value from PUMA
review:
I recently purchased these PUMA shoes from the Myntra app and I’m very happy with the overall experience. The shoes look exactly like the pictures shown online and the design is very stylish. The build quality feels premium and the material is durable yet lightweight.

They are extremely comfortable for daily wear. The cushioning provides good support, making them perfect for long hours of walking. The fit was accurate to size and the grip on the sole is also quite good.

Delivery through Myntra was quick and the packaging was neat. Overall, this is a great purchase and definitely worth the price. I would highly recommend these shoes to anyone looking for a combination of style, comfort, and quality.

author: Akash Anup
title: Disappointing Experience: Missing Items and Failed Investigation by Myntra
review:
I recently ordered two Jack and Jones and one HRX track suits from Myntra, and unfortunately, my experience turned out to be extremely disappointing. While the delivery was prompt, within one week, the contents of the packages were far from satisfactory. Instead of receiving complete track suits, I found only the track pants in each package; the jackets were missing from all three.

Understandably frustrated, I promptly raised multiple complaints with Myntra's customer service team. However, despite communicating with them tirelessly for over a week, the response remained dishearteningly consistent. According to Myntra, the products had allegedly passed all quality checks, and they insisted that the delivered items were not tampered with.

This lack of accountability and failure to acknowledge the issue left me with three track pants but no jackets, rendering the entire purchase useless for my intended purpose. As a consumer, this experience has left me deeply dissatisfied with Myntra's service. Despite their claims of quality assurance, their inability to address a clear problem within their supply chain reflects poorly on their commitment to customer satisfaction.

Regrettably, I cannot recommend Myntra based on my recent experience, and I have no intention of using their services again in the future.

author: Meghami12
title: So disappointed
review:
I recently had two very disappointing experiences with Myntra.

The first order was a necklace from the Rubans brand. The expected shipping date was 14th–15th, but even by the 16th, the order had not been shipped. Since it was still unshipped, I tried to cancel it. The app showed that the cancellation would be processed within 20 minutes, but even after several hours, the order was not cancelled and no refund was initiated. This has unnecessarily blocked my money and prevented me from placing another order.

The second and more serious issue was with a bridal chooda ordered for my sister’s wedding. We received a completely wrong product of very poor quality instead of what we had ordered. We immediately requested an exchange, but the delivery kept getting delayed for several days. Each time we contacted customer support, we were simply asked to “wait for another day” with no clear resolution. Eventually, the exchange order got automatically cancelled without being delivered, even though it showed the product was in Delhi. We then had to contact customer care again to initiate a return.

This entire experience has been extremely frustrating:
- Wrong products being delivered  
- Unreliable exchange process  
- Continuous delivery delays  
- Ineffective customer support with no real solutions  

If a product is not available, it should be marked out of stock instead of putting customers through such inconvenience.

This kind of service, especially for important occasions like a wedding, is completely unacceptable. I hope Myntra takes this seriously and improves its service quality and seller verification process.

author: Snakshi
title: Myntra: A Fashion Lover’s Paradise
review:
Myntra is a one-stop destination for fashion enthusiasts! With an extensive range of clothing, accessories, and footwear, it caters to every style and occasion. The user-friendly app and website make shopping a breeze, offering detailed filters, accurate size guides, and easy navigation.
One of Myntra’s standout features is its amazing discounts and frequent sales, making premium brands affordable. Delivery is swift, packaging is secure, and the return/exchange policy is seamless. Customer service is prompt and resolves queries efficiently.
Myntra not only keeps up with the latest trends but also ensures quality and variety, making it a reliable choice for every shopper. Highly recommended for anyone looking to elevate their wardrobe effortlessly!

review: I hv been using myntra for almost 6years now or more . This app has everything but one thing is that  is horrible here is customer service . There is no ‘chat ‘ options and the mailing options takes forever to solve a problem (sometimes they just close the issue without giving any resolution). The calling options has only two language English and Hindi. In our country not everyone can speak english or hindi . Other platforms provide all the regional languages customers service but as being the india’s biggest fashion hub cant even have a proper customer service. The people in the customer service are also not very prompt on what they are doing . I hope they will really start giving value to their customers .

author: Shopsrinivas
title: Serious Security flaws
review: I have been using Myntra for very long time but recently the wallet functionality (Myntra Credit) has serious security issue. I had around ₹1700 in  Myntra credit account added via refunds in Sept 2018. Somehow a fraudulent transaction happend on May 1st 2019, without my knowledge. My account phone number was changed and an order was placed using the money from my myntra credit wallet. Today I complained to Myntra about this and they are asking me to lodge a complaint with cyber crime police and trying to wash off their hands. When the wallet is maintained by Myntra, if there is fraudulent transactions happen Myntra should take action instead of asking the customer to go to police station. If it was a bank transaction I would’ve asked the bank but here the security issue is in Myntra wallet. There should be at least an OTP based authentication done when using money from wallet. No checks directly debited. This incident is an causing me to think about all services offered by Flipkart and its subsidiaries

author: Chikki2001
title: Extremely disappointed with myntra’s customer service and false promises
review:

review: A similar incident happened to us; we ordered a suitcase from Myntra. Unfortunately the size was small, and we need bigger ones. I filled out a return. Luckily, I had evidence of them picking up the order. Myntra didn't cooperate with us; we got to hear the same message from them: "The order is not picked up." They didn't want to look up the evidence. So we took things into our own hands, traced the vehicle number, and found their address. They somehow return the product to Myntra even after the return window is closed, and we get the refund. Without any help from Myntra. Always record the unboxing and return video.

author: Navinadi
title: Product Quality and Overall experience
review:
I've been using Myntra for a while now, and overall, my experience has been positive. The app interface is smooth and easy to navigate, with a wide variety of brands and products to choose from. The product quality has generally been good, though occasionally, I’ve received items that didn’t match the expectations based on pictures.

Delivery is fast, and the return process is seamless, which I appreciate. However, I would love to see more consistency in the product descriptions and sizing details.

Overall, Myntra is my go-to app for fashion shopping, but a little more attention to detail could make it even better!

author: BrajMona
title: Lack of Accountability and Ineffective Customer Service
review:
I have experienced a significant decline in service quality over the past few months. On multiple occasions, my orders have arrived with issues such as incorrect sizes, wrong items, or missing products altogether. This has made shopping on the platform increasingly unreliable.

What is even more frustrating is the lack of proper customer support. In cases where incorrect products were delivered, I tried reaching out for assistance, but the support team was unhelpful and failed to resolve the issue. Instead of addressing the problem, the responsibility was often shifted onto me as the customer, with claims being denied without proper investigation or resolution.

Overall, the combination of frequent order errors and poor customer service has made the experience disappointing. I hope the company takes steps to address these issues and improve customer satisfaction.

You have lost a loyal customer, Myntra! Shame on you!

author: Fit Mohit
title: Superb Quality and Amazing colour combination
review:
Absolutely loved this laptop bag! 😊 From the moment I opened the package, I was impressed by the quality and stylish design. It feels sturdy and well-made, giving me confidence that my laptop is well protected. The padding is excellent, and the compartments are thoughtfully designed—plenty of space for my charger, notebook, and other essentials.

What I appreciate most is how comfortable it is to carry, even when it’s fully packed. The straps are soft yet supportive, making it perfect for daily use. Overall, this bag is a perfect blend of functionality and style. I’m extremely happy with my purchase and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable and classy laptop bag! 🌟

author: Shivalya1722
title: PATHETIC CUSTOMER SERVICE
review: I have been a myntra customer since a long time now. So I ordered a nike shoes worth 10k Got it delivered fine but i always wear uk7 size this time its too tight for me so I exchanged them for uk8 still they were tight, I decided to return them. The next day pickup person came and refused to pick the shoes because there was minimal dust like miscroscopic dust on the sole which is fine i said i will clean it completely for you he said that i can clean it and then he can come back to pick it up which was completely misleading. Myntra rejected my claim on just a statement of the pickup person that the shoes were used which they were not. Already contacted customer service multiple times, every time they go ahead and open a case and give me a notification that the case is closed without contacting me or asking me for mu justification. Atleast they should give me a chance to prove myself. This is completely inhuman and i am not using myntra again.

author: Ms Ghosh
title: Cheap tactics
review:
Few days back I ordered one top from Myntra. That top didn’t fit me well and also I didn’t like the quality. So I issued a return request. The pickup guy came and rejected to pick it up as according to him the colour of the top wasn’t the same. It’s the most bizzare excuse I have ever heard. There’s still the tag attached to the top and I was given this bizzare excuse for the rejection. I couldn’t argue much with the pick up guy as he insisted that his amount will be deducted and I didn’t want him to suffer for Myntra’s bizzare policy. However, I called the customer care twice and I was assured that my issue will be resolved and another pick up attempt would be made on 23rd June. There was no such attempt. I am totally upset by their lack of responsibility and I am not going to buy any more items from Myntra. 
If you can’t resolve a problem of your customer, then it’s better you lose them.

author: Neepa Patel
title: Service has gone down
review:
I got something which I didn’t order and so I tried to apply return for the same bcaz exchange option was not available on that particular item; I had no option den to return the product. I tried doing same thro app but app is not working properly since 2-3 mths and it is creating problems when u opt for return. Den I had to call Myntra executive, he helped me filing return; the product was taken up after 2 days. So, I was expecting refund of that particular product which was wrongly got delivered to me instead of what I actually ordered. It’s been 18 days now and I called up and informed Myntra executives twice that I have not received Myntra credit for the product. But every time they are saying wait for 3-4 days. Myntra claims immediate refund in terms of Myntra credit option; then why I have still not received my refund? And they are not even sorry for delivery wrong product and for the delay of refund !! 
Completely Upset with the process !

author: Aakanksha malhotra
title: Myntra itself is wonderful! App has bugs
review:
You are a completely customer driven company, if so please do care for the following- 

1. If I placed an order of 5 items in total, the order shows up for each of the item separately in Orders. Thats fine but when I return, ideally i will have to return each one of them separately, thats also fine. BUT when i place the return request for the first item of those 5 , it shows me the returning amount as the total of 5 items confusing me that placing return request for this is automatically placing the return request for all 5. It actually happenned with me, i actually handed out all 5 items to the pick up agent, but later when I received the amount it was just for one item. The pick up agent was kind and helpful, that on talking with him he actually brought the rest of the items back to me. PLEASE FIX THIS. Either don’t show the total amount at returning 1 item or actually mean it. 

2. When I place an order and go back to orders, i don’t get to see it immidiately updated. It takes time i have to either kill the app multiple times or come back a bit later to see my order. 

And Yes I AM A QA. So i have this instincts and a zeal to get all these fixed :)

author: Anu_shri-A
title: Very bad myntra service and customer support experience. I would have given -ve but no option to do.
review:
Extremely disappointed with Myntra’s service! 😡

I ordered a product and after several delays, finally received it — damaged. I placed a replacement request which was supposed to be delivered by 5th November, but nothing arrived. After raising a complaint, I was told I’d get it by 11th November. That too passed — and still no product!

Every time I contact support, I get the same robotic replies — “please wait 48 hours” or “you’ll get a call from a senior within 24 hours.” It’s been days — no one has ever called.

The tracking is just ridiculous — my parcel keeps moving from Patna to the destination hub, back to Patna, then to nearby locations, and again back to Patna! It’s been stuck in a never-ending loop!

Despite multiple complaints, there’s no resolution — only endless apologies. When a package travels like this, no wonder it arrives damaged. I even complained about that, but again, no proper action was taken.

Honestly, at this point, it feels buying from a local store is far more reliable than depending on Myntra’s pathetic logistics and customer support. The service quality has dropped badly — it’s all “sorry for the inconvenience” and no real help.

Really disappointed, Myntra. Never expected this kind of poor experience from you. 👎

author: bowtruckle7
title: Zero customer support
review: I have been using myntra since 10 years. And this time I am really frustrated. There is no way you can reach their customer support. author: fahmi96abd
title: Worst customer service
review: I’ve been ordering from myntra for more than 8 years. The service was good in the beginning. Recently I had to exchange a product and return another because the size was not correct. author: MonicaSingh—
title: It was my favourite app once, now it’s headache.
review:
I have been using Myntra since 2012 and used to love it until 2025. The app technically doesn’t have issues but the services of company have gone beyond pathetic. Since April 2025 (more than a year) not a single order got delivered WITHOUT multiple complaints, follow ups, several hours spent on trying to connect with them. It is horrible. The entire reason I loved online-shopping was I didn’t time for going to markets frequently. Now Myntra makes me waste my work hours, lunch breaks, family time and weekends trying to connect with some human on their customer support only to hear that complaint is already registered with NO solution. 

There are still due deliveries since 20 days while I am writing the review. And I am almost sure that they will do nothing about it, let it be for 10 more days and then cancel it from their end. 

Horrible customer experience.
